scope.selection: Five manually selected case studies used to test whether a reliability-aware repair can be constructed and validated.
scope.claim_boundary: The outcomes are case-specific proof-of-concept results and do not estimate effectiveness over the 67 generation attempts, the 18 generated-patch cases, or any wider population.

verdicts.pass: The cited case-specific gate produced the required positive evidence.
verdicts.fail: The cited gate produced a confirmed violation or rejected the candidate.
verdicts.unknown: The gate was not reached or lacked a valid witness; unknown is neither pass nor fail.
verdicts.not_applicable: The repair design does not contain the mechanism targeted by this gate.

acceptance.patch_apply: The saved unified diff applies with zero fuzz to the frozen source revision.
acceptance.compile: The affected project or reactor compiles with the candidate applied.
acceptance.ordinary: A successful final candidate passes 100 independently started ordinary target executions.
acceptance.causal_replay: The matched unpatched control must non-pass under the witnessed recorded-delay trigger, and every credited repaired run must pass under the same trigger. One confirmed repaired non-pass is sufficient to reject causal effectiveness.
acceptance.missing_completion: When applicable, a witnessed missing producer or publication terminates through the repair's bounded diagnostic before the outer deadline.
acceptance.interruption: When applicable, a witnessed interrupt terminates the wait and propagates InterruptedException or preserves interrupt status.
acceptance.multi_writer: Counter-like repairs require a coordinated multi-writer probe with exact observed counts.
acceptance.noninterference: Applicable neighboring-test and reused-JVM checks must pass. Parallel execution is pass only with a durable overlap witness and otherwise remains unknown.

overall_verdict.pass: The candidate passes patch application, compilation, 100 ordinary runs, matched causal replay, and the additional case-specific gates that were applicable and executed.
overall_verdict.fail: The candidate is rejected at a required gate. Later gates may remain unknown after the stopping rule fires.
overall_verdict.stopping_rule: Do not widen a frozen test oracle merely to make a candidate pass; preserve the blocker or failed causal witness instead.
